storage.writer: one serialized SQLite connection for writes and transactions
storage.readers: four query_only WAL connections for memory recall and consolidation candidate reads

measurement.fixture: 32 topic clusters; distinct 1024d vectors and text; source evidence; entity and parent graphs; one concurrent extraction/embedding/consolidation worker

capacity.scope: 20 warm calls per size through the real Engine, SQLite adapter and production token counter. A fixed query embedding excludes provider latency. Records form 32 topic clusters with distinct vectors and text, source evidence, entity mentions and parent links; a fifth carry a second revision. ColdMS, P50MS, P95MS measure candidate scans; StandardP95MS measures the complete local recall; MixedP95MS repeats it while one extraction, embedding and consolidation worker runs. ExtraRSS covers scan and recall with 5 ms RSS sampling. CancelMS starts at cancellation after the second scan page.

scenarios: forget excludes current and historical records
native_runtime.storage: isolated temporary database and knowledge repository

limits: The frozen corpus contains 17 synthetic dated owner statements, 60 queries and one separate assistant-suggestion guard; all 61 expected evidence sources were retrieved in this run.
Citation validation checks exact source substrings on a bounded corpus; it is not a guarantee for arbitrary future model output.
The int8 shortlist is approximate; final cosine ranking uses original float32 vectors.
Terms matching more than 4096 records do not take part in keyword ranking; the semantic route covers them.
Keyword terms shorter than three characters use a LIKE scan over current records.
The 100000-record cold candidate scan took 3176.3 ms. Provider latency and a cold complete recall are outside the warm local capacity gate.
Production migration and deployment have not been performed. Mobile UI and wire schemas are unchanged.
